test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some kites are balloons.

No balloon is a plane.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some kites are planes.

(II): Some balloons are kites.
solution:
Statements:

Some kites are balloons.

No balloon is a plane.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11474f878b59d548027f183f65d8d0a19a953076fad7ad5c09a958909252685e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some kites are planes. - False (There is no definite relation between kites and planes, it can be possible but it is not definite)

(II): Some balloons are kites. - **True **(Because Some kites are balloons, which means Some balloons are kites.)

Thus, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
